text.observations: Each copy role is present once. No other readable copy, logo, QR or watermark was observed.

style.checked_requirement: Fine observational urban-wear drawing, long contours, dense short metal marks and sparse stone marks, restrained transparent colors, mincho typography.

observations.location: Right metal door and upper handle
observations.observation: Close cropped door and attached handle are depicted with graphite-like edges, grey-blue fields and rust. Strong glossy shading and dense granular surface detail give the material a photographic impression.
Large connected threshold and pavement show wear and joints; the stone has dense stippled and granular detail rather than a visibly sparse light-line treatment.

ratio.observation: PNG header and helper manifest record 1024 x 1536; no resizing performed.

observations.location: Right vertical door edge through lower two-thirds
observations.observation: Door wear, threshold edge and pavement fissures form a continuous close urban scene and communicate repeated use and attentive observation.

format.observation: One flat opaque single poster is visible; no comparison panels, room mockup, frame or contact sheet.

observations.observation: Title has stable mincho forms, distinct two-line grouping and strong dark weight.
Body glyph bodies, open counters and word spaces remain readable; commas and sentence-ending periods are distinct and the four lines connect naturally.
The large title is the first typographic anchor; the body begins below on the same left axis.

observations.location: Body right boundary and threshold below
observations.observation: The cropped vertical door and the large diagonal threshold guide the view from text into the worn surfaces. The text sits on the open wall region of the same scene.

function_contact.applicability: No depicted hand action or required functional/contact task; attached handle, lock and door connections inspected.
function_contact.observation: Handle and lock fixtures attach to the door; threshold and pavement form adjacent levels.

observations.location: Door jamb, threshold corner and pavement cracks
observations.observation: Edges are distinguishable; the blue-grey metal, stone chips and rust patches remain connected to their surfaces.
Dense high-detail tonal rendering makes drawn stroke pressure and density less conspicuous.

default_exclusion.observation: Substantive full-scale worn door/threshold/pavement relationships organize the composition, rather than a tiny picture on an information board. The text region is an open portion of this connected scene.

residuals.location: Right handle and lower stone surfaces
residuals.observation: Photographic gloss and dense granular texture dominate over the assigned long-contour and sparse-versus-dense short-stroke drawing grammar; targeted style repair is planned.
Actual post-await end timestamp was evaluated but not retained because of a post-return store(undefined) exception; native return and source are preserved and not relabeled as a failed invocation.

decision.cause: Make observational linework visibly carry material description while retaining accurate readable copy, connected scene and existing mincho hierarchy.
